import sys
def solve(lines):
    h=len(lines); w=len(lines[0])
    flat=''.join(lines)
    s=flat.find('S'); e=flat.find('E')
    if s<0 or e<0: return -1
    blocked=bytearray(c=='#' for c in flat.encode() and flat) if False else bytearray(1 if c=='#' else 0 for c in flat)
    blocked[s]=1
    fr=[s]; d=0
    while fr:
        d+=1; nx=[]
        for p in fr:
            x=p%w
            for q,ok in ((p-w,p>=w),(p+w,p<(h-1)*w),(p-1,x>0),(p+1,x<w-1)):
                if ok and not blocked[q]:
                    if q==e: return d
                    blocked[q]=1; nx.append(q)
        fr=nx
    return -1
if __name__=="__main__":
    L=[l.rstrip('\n') for l in sys.stdin if l.strip()]
    print(solve(L))
